title: PCGExKnowledge plugin file
description: Full knowledge entries for one plugin. To resolve any id appearing anywhere in the bundle (a search hit, an inherits pointer, a see reference, a variant class): check each plugin file's nodes map, then its aliases map. That is the only resolution path, and every emitted id resolves through it. References may cross files: sibling plugins inherit from bases documented in PCGExtendedToolkit.json.

version.description: The plugin's .uplugin VersionName at render time.

aliases.description: Variant classes (nodes documented as one family) and covered helper classes, mapped to the id of the entry documenting them.

enums.description: Every enum referenced by this file's settings, keyed by C++ enum name. Hidden values are omitted.

nodes.description: Entries keyed by id (the C++ settings class name).

name.description: Display name as the palette or the page shows it. For a variant family, the family name.

category.description: Palette category prefix, when the display name carries one.

module.description: The C++ module the source header lives in.

classification.description: node / provider / instanced_factory / factory_data / shared_struct / asset.

presets.description: Preconfigured palette entries of this node.

variants.description: Sibling nodes documented by this one entry. Their ids appear in the file's aliases map.

covers.description: Helper classes from the same header, documented here. Their ids appear in the file's aliases map.

purpose.description: What it is for. Verbatim card prose; **Bold Name** marks a node reference.

situation.description: One sentence naming the kind of problem this node answers.

text.description: What the element actually does to N points / M inputs; predicts output shape and count.

off_label.description: Verified unconventional uses, each grounded in a code path.

pins.description: The verified pin contract, including conditional pins.

condition.description: Present when the pin is mode-dependent.

dynamic.description: How dynamic pin sets behave, when the node has them.

settings.description: The node's own editable properties, keyed by C++ property name, plus any inherited property the documentation keyed content to (marked with `from`). Everything else inherited is reached through `inherits`.

inherits.description: Documented ancestor ids, nearest first. Fetch them for the shared settings surface.

hints.description: Failure modes and warnings, anchored to the mechanic they concern.

anchor.description: whats_it_for / mechanism / pins, or a property name.

addenda.description: Operator-supplied durable knowledge no header derivation can reach (console variables, cross-module context, workflow notes).

file.description: Header path relative to its plugin's Source root.

hash.description: Content hash of the header + cpp pair the card was authored against.

stale.description: True when the source has changed since authoring. Absent means current.

display.description: The label the details panel shows.

from.description: Declaring class, present only on inherited properties promoted into this entry.

default.description: Raw C++ initializer text. Enum defaults resolve through the file's enums table.

enum.description: Key into the file's enums table.

overridable.description: Exposed as a PCG graph override pin.

edit_condition_hides.description: The condition hides the setting rather than disabling it.

see.description: Id of the entry documenting this struct-typed settings block.

fields.description: Inline fields of a struct-typed setting that has no entry of its own.

inlined_in_panel.description: The struct's fields appear directly in the panel rather than as a collapsible group (ShowOnlyInnerProperties).

semantics.description: Authored: interaction, consequence, unit or space the tooltip does not carry. Absence means the tooltip suffices.

trap.description: Authored: the way this setting surprises people.

interacts_with.description: Property names this one changes meaning with.
